Home.headline: One system for the whole job.
Home.subhead: Garages run on trust, and on a lot of retyping. Motivox removes the retyping and makes the trust visible: a signed quote, photos on every line, a status the customer can check themselves.
Home.bayTitle: Jobs the way the shop runs, digital.
Home.baySub: Plate, work, and status at a glance. No whiteboard. No sticky notes.
Home.step1Body: Customer and vehicle stay on the same file. Your checklists, status per item, licence-plate lookup via RDW (including APK date). Findings feed the quote, no second inventory.
Home.step2Body: Work plan from the inspection plus your services library. Printable PDF in the shop, or a secure link with signature and timestamp. Then the customer picks a slot.
Home.step3Body: Work order from the approved plan. Timer or manual hours, parts and consumables. Invoice from the same rules, pro forma or final.
Home.portalBody: Customers sign the quote, then pick an appointment slot (no cold self-booking), follow the repair, and download the invoice. Online pay if you connected Mollie or Tikkie.
Home.portalImageAlt: Technician working in a garage workshop
Home.heroImageAlt: Dutch auto repair shop floor, context for Motivox garage software
Home.ctaImageAlt: Tools and workshop environment at an auto repair shop
Home.rolesSub: Everyone works in one system, with exactly the tools their role needs.
Home.roleBackBody: Customers, inspection, quotes, planning, hour approval, and invoicing, no Excel islands.
Home.roleTechBody: Own web portal: dashboard and schedule, work order, inspection on the floor, timer or manual hours, photos and video on the line.
Home.roleCustBody: Sign the quote, pick a slot after approval, follow status, download the invoice, with a one-time code or a secure link. No password to forget in the waiting room.
Home.faq1A: Motivox is Dutch-first garage workshop software (SaaS) by Innovolabs B.V. One system for intake, inspection, approval, shop-floor work, hours, parts, and invoice, without retyping.
Home.faq2A: Yes. 30 days, and it is the full Garage version, live shop planning included. No mandatory demo call; you start yourself via onboarding.
Home.faq3A: Three web portals on one source of truth: back office, technician, and customer. There is no separate native iOS or Android app.
Home.faq4A: ZZP €35 or Garage €80 per month excl. VAT. Extra seats (Garage) €4 per month. Billing via Stripe with a Dutch VAT invoice.
Home.faq5Q: How do VAT and payments work?
Home.faq5A: Your Motivox subscription runs through Stripe (iDEAL, SEPA, or card); Stripe Tax adds VAT. Customers can pay online if you connect Mollie or Tikkie.
Home.finalCtaTitle: Less retyping. More time under the bonnet.
Home.finalCtaBody: Sign up. You get a trial, then onboarding with company details, rates, and logo.
Home.faq6Q: I work alone. Is this overkill?
Home.faq6A: No, that is what ZZP (€35) is for. One account switches between office and workshop, you get planned as a technician yourself, and you count once towards your plan.
Home.pulseTitle: Know how the day is going before the coffee is cold.
Home.pulseBody: Your dashboard, your tiles. Drag them, resize them, keep only what you actually look at, low stock, each technician’s workload, what needs action today.
Home.liveTitle: Monday morning, without the phone tree.
Home.liveBody: Arrivals, night-drop cars, replanned appointments and real shop capacity on one board, plus a team cockpit that shows who is clocked on and what they have on.

Features.title: Everything the shop needs

Features.storyTitle: The Golf is outside. Brakes squeal.
Features.storyIntro: The real flow: inspection → quote → approval → floor → invoice. Customer, car, and job stay the same chain.
Features.beat1Body: Your own inspection checklists: sections, items, order. Per item OK, attention, urgent, or n/a plus a note. Save as draft, finalize, then read-only. Findings carry into the quote.
Features.beat2Title: A quote the customer can trust.
Features.beat2Body: A work plan with multiple lines, built from the inspection and your services library. Printable PDF for an in-shop signature, or a secure link with signature and timestamp, by email.
Features.beat3Body: Work order from the approved plan. Assign and schedule technicians. The customer picks a slot from the same shop capacity. Timer (one running) or manual hours, photos and video on the line.
Features.beat4Body: Approve or reject hours (with a reason). Then a pro forma or final invoice from hours, parts, and consumables. PDF download via a secure link, no attachment by default.

Pricing.title: Two plans. Thirty days to find out if you’d miss it.
Pricing.intro: Your trial is the full Garage version, live shop planning included. After 30 days, pick ZZP or Garage, monthly via Stripe, prices excl. VAT.
Pricing.trialNote: No required demo call. A second shop: its own registration + wizard.
Pricing.zzpTagline: For the one-person shop, and maybe one helper.
Pricing.garageTagline: For teams that run intake to invoice together.
Pricing.extraSeats: Need more accounts on Garage? Extra seats are €4 per month excl. VAT per account. On ZZP, the upgrade is the answer.
Pricing.finePrint: Prices excl. VAT. Activate your subscription in Motivox via Stripe. Garage group (unlimited seats) on request.
Pricing.enterpriseLink: Garage group or onboarding questions? Contact us →
Pricing.included1Body: New features without separate upgrade fees.
Pricing.included2Body: Email support on business days, NL/EN.
Pricing.included3Body: Secure cloud hosting and backups. Each shop sees only its own data.
Pricing.included4Body: Office vs technician, plus multi-factor authentication for staff.
Pricing.faq1A: Sign up. After email confirmation you go through onboarding. You get a 30-day trial; then activate ZZP or Garage under Settings → Subscription.
Pricing.faq2A: Monthly via Stripe (iDEAL, SEPA, or card). Prices are excl. VAT; Stripe Tax adds VAT. You get a Dutch VAT invoice.
Pricing.faq3A: No, cancel monthly via the Stripe customer portal in Motivox.
Pricing.faq4A: Yes, when your shop has connected Mollie or Tikkie. That is separate from your Motivox subscription.
Pricing.zzpFeatSolo: Solo mode: one login for office and workshop
Pricing.garageFeatPlanning: Live shop planning: arrivals, night-drop, capacity, team cockpit
Pricing.valueTitle: The cheapest hour is the one you forgot to bill.
Pricing.valueBody: If your hourly rate is above €35, a single forgotten hour pays for a month of ZZP. That is the job of this software: not to be clever, but to stop money leaking out of the gaps between your tools.
Pricing.value1: Hours are approved, then invoiced, not remembered on Friday.
Pricing.value2: Consumables are added by rule (default 8% of labour), not by feel.
Pricing.value3: APK reminders bring customers back without anyone picking up the phone.
Pricing.faq5Q: What do I get during the trial?
Pricing.faq5A: The full Garage version for 30 days, live shop planning included. Afterwards you choose ZZP or Garage; live shop planning is part of Garage.
Pricing.faq6Q: Can I add extra seats on ZZP?
Pricing.faq6A: ZZP includes you plus one extra account (office or technician). Need more people? Upgrade to Garage, extra seats at €4 per month are available there.

garageSoftware.metaTitle: Garage software for Dutch repair shops, Motivox
garageSoftware.metaDescription: Garage software from intake to invoice in one system: inspection, quote, work order, hours and VAT invoice. Try free for 30 days, from €35 per month.
garageSoftware.title: Garage software that keeps the whole job in one system
garageSoftware.intro: Motivox is garage software for Dutch auto repair shops. From intake and inspection to work order, hours, parts, and invoice: you enter each detail once and everyone works from the same file.

sections.title: What is garage software?
sections.body: Garage software is a program a repair shop uses to manage customers, vehicles, work orders, hours, parts, and invoices. Motivox runs in the browser with nothing to install, and the office, technicians, and customers all see the same live status.

sections.title: Intake to invoice, no retyping
sections.body: Look up the vehicle by licence plate (RDW, including the APK date), run the inspection, send a quote with digital signature, schedule the work order, log hours and parts, and create a pro forma or final invoice as a PDF. Enter it once, use it everywhere.

sections.title: Three portals, one source of truth
sections.body: The office plans and invoices. The technician sees only their own work and logs hours with a timer. The customer follows status, approves work, and pays online when Mollie or Tikkie is connected.

sections.title: Built for the Netherlands
sections.body: Dutch VAT invoices, KvK details, and integrations with Exact Online, Moneybird, and e-Boekhouden. Export as CSV or UBL. You pay for your subscription by iDEAL, SEPA, or card.

faq.q: What does Motivox garage software cost?
faq.a: ZZP costs €35 per month and Garage costs €80 per month, both excl. VAT. Extra accounts on Garage cost €4 per month excl. VAT.
Yes. You get a 30-day trial with everything in the Garage plan. A demo call is not required.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No. Motivox runs in the browser on desktop, tablet, and shop-floor screens. There is no separate iOS or Android app.
Motivox runs in the cloud with backups, strict separation between shops, and MFA for staff.

workshopSoftware.metaTitle: Workshop software for auto repair shops, Motivox
workshopSoftware.metaDescription: Workshop software with live planning, a technician portal and a customer portal. Fewer calls and less retyping, more time under the car. Try free for 30 days.
workshopSoftware.title: Workshop software for a calmer, more predictable shop floor
workshopSoftware.intro: Motivox gives your workshop an overview: who is working on what, which car is where, and what is waiting for approval. Your planning, technicians, and customers all work in the same system.

sections.title: Live shop planning
sections.body: See arrivals, cars dropped off after hours, appointments that need replanning, and your shop's capacity. The plan adapts as the floor changes.

sections.title: A technician portal that helps
sections.body: Technicians see their own work orders, start a timer or book hours manually, and record parts and consumables. No paper job cards getting lost.

sections.title: Customers who stop calling
sections.body: In the customer portal the owner follows status, views the inspection, approves work, and sees the invoice. That means fewer calls at the front desk.

sections.title: Your own dashboard
sections.body: Build tiles for revenue, open invoices, schedule, low stock, and technician workload, so you see every morning where things are tight.

faq.q: Is live shop planning in every plan?
faq.a: Live shop planning is in the Garage plan and during the trial. ZZP has a solo mode instead, where you switch between office and workshop.

faq.q: How many technicians can I add?
faq.a: Garage includes 3 back office and 5 technician accounts. Extra accounts cost €4 per month excl. VAT. A group with unlimited seats is available on request.

faq.q: Does it work on a tablet in the shop?
faq.a: Yes. Motivox is a web application and works on desktop, tablet, and shop-floor screens.

soloGarage.metaTitle: Garage software for solo mechanics and small shops, Motivox
soloGarage.metaDescription: Garage software for the independent mechanic or small shop: quote, work order, hours and invoice in one tool. ZZP plan €35 per month, 30-day trial.
soloGarage.title: Garage software for the independent mechanic
soloGarage.intro: Working alone or with one helper? You don't want an expensive package full of features you never use. Motivox's ZZP plan costs €35 per month excl. VAT and covers the whole job from inspection to invoice.

sections.title: One account, two roles
sections.body: In solo mode you switch between office and workshop in a single account. Make the quote at the desk and log your hours under the car, without a second subscription.

sections.title: Professional from quote to invoice
sections.body: Send a quote with digital signature, record work and parts, and send a clean VAT invoice as a PDF. Customers follow status in their portal.

sections.title: Included: you plus one extra account
sections.body: The ZZP plan includes the owner and one extra account for office or technician. When the business grows, upgrade to Garage for live planning and more accounts.

sections.title: Bookkeeping stays simple
sections.body: Connect Moneybird, Exact Online, or e-Boekhouden, or export invoices as CSV or UBL. Let customers pay online through Mollie or Tikkie.

faq.q: What does Motivox cost for a solo mechanic?
faq.a: The ZZP plan costs €35 per month excl. VAT, cancellable monthly. Try it first for 30 days with everything in Garage.

faq.q: What is the difference between ZZP and Garage?
faq.a: ZZP is for the owner plus one extra account, with solo mode. Garage (€80) has 3 back office and 5 technician accounts and live shop planning.
Yes. You can move to Garage as soon as your team grows.

workOrders.metaTitle: Work order software for garages, Motivox
workOrders.metaDescription: Work order software for auto repair shops: work orders, time tracking, parts and invoicing linked together. No retyping. Try free for 30 days.
workOrders.title: Work order software where hours and parts flow onto the invoice
workOrders.intro: The work order is the heart of your shop. In Motivox it starts at the inspection, moves through your technicians, and ends as an invoice, without anyone entering the data again.

sections.title: From inspection to work order
sections.body: Findings from the inspection become lines on the quote. Once the customer approves, by printed PDF or a secure link with signature and timestamp, it becomes your work order.

sections.title: Time tracking with a timer
sections.body: Technicians start a timer or book hours manually on the work order. You see what was worked per job, and what is planned per technician.

sections.title: Parts and consumables
sections.body: Record parts and consumables on the work order, apply line discounts on labour and materials, and keep an eye on low stock on your dashboard.

sections.title: Invoice in one click
sections.body: Hours, parts, and discounts become a pro forma or final invoice as a PDF, with Dutch VAT. Credit notes take a few clicks.

faq.a: Software a workshop uses to register jobs, assign them to technicians, track hours and parts, and finally invoice.

faq.q: Can customers approve a work order?
faq.a: Yes. Customers approve through a printed PDF in the shop or a secure link with digital signature and timestamp.
Yes. Technicians use a timer or enter hours manually.
